title: FAQ: What is the duration of the drone pilot course?
content: The DGCA Remote Pilot training course is 5 to 7 days long. It consists of 2 days of online/offline theory instruction, followed by simulator training and 3 days of practical flight experience on our flying field in Indore.

title: FAQ: Is a physical medical certificate required?
content: Yes, candidates must obtain a medical fitness certificate from a registered MBBS doctor before starting practical flight training. This is a mandatory DGCA requirement.

title: FAQ: What is the validity of the DGCA Remote Pilot License?
content: The Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) issued by our DGCA-approved RPTO is valid for up to 10 years and can be renewed upon expiration.

title: FAQ: Do you provide food and accommodation during training?
content: The standard course fees (₹20,000 for Small Class, ₹25,000 for Multirotor) do not include food and accommodation. However, our training coordinators can assist you in finding budget-friendly lodging near the training facility.
